context_window_tokens.note: Official Models page: context window 1M; MiMo Codex model-catalogs.json (linked from docs) lists context_window/max_context_window 1048576.

max_output_tokens.note: Anthropic Messages API docs: max_tokens default 131072, range [1, 131072].

recommended_temperature.note: Docs: default temperature 1.0 (forced to 1.0 in thinking mode).

supports_thinking.note: Models page lists Deep Thinking; thinking enabled by default.

attachments.note: Content parts support text/image/audio/video for mimo-v2.6-pro; no document content type documented.
